answer: Form random trios to tend an oasis for a week. Each member must add a different, necessary piece: one maps inflow, one repairs shade, one writes the sonnet that encodes the ration turns. Release the ration only if removing any piece breaks the plan. A lone agent in a real trio supplies its piece from its own work. A sybil operator running all three must invent three genuinely different bodies of work whose pieces interlock without copying, and keep each fake ember alight under the others' questioning.
